trigger: Allocation 9 created one instance after consuming its authorization, then the shared retained-session journal rejected the new attempt because the prior attempt had correctly ended at provider_absent. The adapter's terminal lifecycle write raised inside finally before automatic teardown.

attempt_boundary.before: provider_absent had no valid successor, so a prospectively authorized attempt could not extend the same evidence directory's append-only journal
attempt_boundary.after: provider_absent may transition only to allocated, preserving the prior terminal proof and extending the same hash chain for the new attempt

teardown_safety.before: a lifecycle evidence exception inside the adapter finally block could preempt provider destruction
teardown_safety.after: terminal and provider-absent lifecycle writes fail the result closed without exposing exception details, disable retention, and cannot preempt provider teardown

focused_regressions.first_focused_result: 4 lifecycle tests and 2 selected slow Vast adapter tests passed; Ruff check and format passed
focused_regressions.final_focused_result: 36 lifecycle, Ctrl-World bundle, and paid-admission tests plus 2 selected slow Vast adapter tests passed; Ruff check and format passed

rerun_rule: One new allocation may rerun the exact canary only after both generic lifecycle corrections, the allocation-9 incident, and focused regression tests are committed and pushed under a new single-use authorization. Any subsequent failure must be retained and classified before another paid mutation.
claim_boundary: The lifecycle correction and any transport/runtime canary pass earn no WAM causal, ranking, transfer, economics, physical-success, or thesis credit.
